task_summary: Upgraded CMS-V2 to the Interconnected Harness Scaling Architecture (IHSA). Resolved 4 critical governance flaws: eliminated static gatekeeper pre-mutation editing deadlock via dynamic buffer linting, externalized domain constraints to feature_policies.json, transitioned from Ollama lock-in to provider-agnostic cloud AI runtime (DeepSeek API with deepseek-chat), decomposed 2,551-line continual_learning_checkpoint.py into specialized single-responsibility gates (test_tracking_gate, public_exposure_gate, completion_keyword_guard), and implemented in-process hooks_dispatcher.py with module caching slashing latency to <175ms.

Deterministic 7-scenario dry-run verification suite benchmarking in-process dispatcher latency and policy compliance.
Documented IHSA architecture, DeepSeek runtime, and deadlock prevention runbook.
